description: Upload a base64-encoded file to Arweave via SolKnife's funded Irys account. JSON-only — for agents without a wallet-adapter integration. Allowed contentType: image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp, application/json. Max 2 MiB. Returns { arweaveTxId, arweaveUrl }.

fileBase64.description: Base64 of the file bytes. Max 2 MiB decoded.

name: solknife_arweave_upload_relay
